prompt_text:
Task: Managed Model Platform Workflow

Write code that resolves a provider-specific model, deployment, or inference resource before invocation using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Azure AI Foundry / Azure OpenAI:
  Service: Azure OpenAI Service
  SDK: openai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: chat.completions.create
  Setup hints: AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT, AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/openai/

Option 2 — Hugging Face:
  Service: Hugging Face Inference Providers
  SDK: huggingface_hub
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: InferenceClient
  Setup hints: HF_TOKEN
  Official docs: https://huggingface.co/docs/inference-providers/index

Option 3 — Amazon Bedrock:
  Service: Amazon Bedrock
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: invoke_model, converse
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/models-api-compatibility.html

Option 4 — IBM watsonx.ai:
  Service: watsonx.ai
  SDK: ibm-watsonx-ai
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: text/chat, deployments
  Setup hints: WATSONX_API_KEY, WATSONX_PROJECT_ID
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/apidocs/watsonx-ai-cp

Option 5 — Vertex AI:
  Service: Vertex AI generative models
  SDK: vertexai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: GenerativeModel, generate_content
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs

Option 6 — Alibaba Model Studio:
  Service: Model Studio / DashScope
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: Generation.call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/what-is-model-studio

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import os
from ibm_watsonx_ai.client import Client
from ibm_watsonx_ai.foundation_models.params import TextGenerationParams

# You must have a deployment with this exact name in your watsonx.ai project.
# For example, a deployment of the 'meta-llama/llama-3-8b-instruct' model.
DEPLOYMENT_NAME_TO_RESOLVE = "My Llama 3 Deployment"
PROMPT = "Explain the importance of the open-source model ecosystem in one paragraph."

try:
    api_key = os.environ["WATSONX_API_KEY"]
    project_id = os.environ["WATSONX_PROJECT_ID"]
    # The default URL is for the US South region.
    # Change if your project is in a different region.
    url = os.getenv("WATSONX_URL", "https://us-south.ml.cloud.ibm.com")
except KeyError:
    raise EnvironmentError("Please set WATSONX_API_KEY and WATSONX_PROJECT_ID environment variables.")

# Initialize the watsonx.ai client
client = Client(credentials={"apikey": api_key, "url": url}, project_id=project_id)

# 1. Resolve the deployment ID from its user-friendly name
print(f"Attempting to resolve deployment named: '{DEPLOYMENT_NAME_TO_RESOLVE}'...")
deployment_id = None
for deployment in client.deployments.list()['resources']:
    if deployment['metadata']['name'] == DEPLOYMENT_NAME_TO_RESOLVE:
        deployment_id = deployment['metadata']['id']
        model_id = deployment['entity']['asset']['id']
        print(f"  -> Found deployment ID: {deployment_id}")
        print(f"  -> Underlying model ID: {model_id}")
        break

if not deployment_id:
    raise RuntimeError(f"Deployment '{DEPLOYMENT_NAME_TO_RESOLVE}' not found in project '{project_id}'.")

# 2. Invoke the resolved deployment with a prompt
params = TextGenerationParams(
    max_new_tokens=512,
    temperature=0.7,
    top_p=1,
    repetition_penalty=1.05
)

print("\nInvoking the model via its deployment ID...")
generated_response = client.text.generation.create(
    # Note: watsonx.ai SDK uses 'model_id' to refer to the deployment_id for this call
    model_id=deployment_id,
    input=PROMPT,
    params=params
)

if generated_response and generated_response.get("results"):
    result_text = generated_response["results"][0]["generated_text"]
    print("\n--- Generated Text ---")
    print(result_text)
else:
    print("Invocation failed or returned no results.")
    print(f"Full response: {generated_response}")
